chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Those in the graves wish that they had one hajj in exchange for the world and all that is in it."

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life and its material possessions
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.الْقُبُورِ: the graves, referring to those who have died
key_terms.حَجَّةً: a single hajj; one act of pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the value of a single hajj after death?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام emphasizes the immense virtue and value of hajj. The hadith teaches that after death, a person realizes that even a single hajj is more desirable than possessing the whole world and all it contains.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2251 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Those in their graves wish they had a single Hajj, even at the cost of the world and all it contains."
